paper_title: Impact of new skeletal isomerization in polymer semiconductors

knowledge_points.content: A skeletal isomerization strategy was employed to design two isomeric polymers, P(DPPT-TT) and P(DPPTT-T), using asymmetric thiophene-flanked diketopyrrolopyrrole (DPP) units and thieno[3,2-b]thiophene (TT) building blocks.
knowledge_points.evidence: Two novel isomeric polymers P(DPPT-TT) and P(DPPTT-T) based on thiophene-flanked diketopyrrolopyrrole, thieno[3,2-b]thiophene and thiophene building units were designed and synthesized via a new skeletal isomerization strategy.

knowledge_points.content: P(DPPTT-T) exhibits a high average hole mobility of 2.14 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ in air-tested OFETs, which is approximately three times higher than that of its isomer P(DPPT-TT).
knowledge_points.evidence: In particular, its average hole mobility reaches 2.14 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, triple that of P(DPPT-TT).

knowledge_points.content: The optimized OFETs based on P(DPPTT-T) show a current on/off ratio (Ion/Ioff) of approximately 4.0 × 10⁵ and a low threshold voltage (VT) of 1.9 V.
knowledge_points.evidence: P(DPPTT-T)-based OFETs showed more excellent hole transport properties with the average mobility reaching 2.14 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ and the Ion/Ioff around 4.0 × 10⁵ and the VT below 2 V.

knowledge_points.content: The superior mobility of P(DPPTT-T) compared to P(DPPT-TT) is attributed to a smaller π–π stacking distance of 3.52 Å versus 3.57 Å, respectively.
knowledge_points.evidence: The π–π stacking distances of P(DPPT-TT) and P(DPPTT-T) thin films were about 3.57 and 3.52 Å, respectively. A relatively closer π–π stacking distance of the P(DPPTT-T) conjugated chains may contribute to its better charge carrier transport.

knowledge_points.content: Both isomeric polymers P(DPPT-TT) and P(DPPTT-T) exhibit very similar optical bandgaps of 1.40 eV and similar HOMO energy levels (-5.12 eV and -5.22 eV, respectively).
knowledge_points.evidence: The HOMO energy levels of P(DPPT-TT) (-5.12 eV) and P(DPPTT-T) (-5.22 eV) were calculated... Both polymers show similar light absorption properties... Eg opt (eV) 1.40 [for both].

knowledge_points.content: Grazing incidence wide-angle X-ray scattering (GIWAXS) reveals that both polymer films exhibit a predominantly 'edge-on' molecular orientation relative to the substrate.
knowledge_points.evidence: In the out-of-plane diffraction patterns, both polymer films only showed strong Bragg peaks of (100)... It can be concluded that both polymer films exhibited predominantly edge-on molecular packing, respective to substrates.

knowledge_points.content: The optimal annealing temperature for enhancing the field-effect mobility of both P(DPPT-TT) and P(DPPTT-T) thin films was found to be 135 °C.
knowledge_points.evidence: The optimized 135 °C-annealed films of polymer-based OFETs was mainly performed... The optimized 135 °C-annealed films of new polymer-based OFETs exhibit obviously improved field-effect mobility.

knowledge_points.content: The isomeric polymers demonstrate high thermal stability with decomposition temperatures (Td) exceeding 410 °C.
knowledge_points.evidence: They also exhibit high thermostability at decomposition temperatures (Td) over 410 °C.

knowledge_points.content: Density functional theory (DFT) calculations show that both polymers possess good backbone co-planarity, with dihedral angles between units being less than 20°.
knowledge_points.evidence: The absolute values of the backbone dihedral angles in these model molecules are less than 20°, indicating good co-planarity of the conjugated backbones.

knowledge_points.content: Significant redshifts of approximately 80 nm in the absorption maxima were observed when cooling chlorobenzene solutions from 90 °C to room temperature, indicating strong molecular aggregation.
knowledge_points.evidence: When the chlorobenzene solutions were cooled from 90 °C to room temperature, significant redshifts of ~80 nm in the absorption maxima were observed. This can be attributed to the molecular aggregation and stacking effects in solution.

knowledge_points.content: The polymers were synthesized via Stille cross-coupling polycondensation and purified through Soxhlet extraction using methanol, petroleum ether, toluene, and finally chloroform.
knowledge_points.evidence: Typical Stille cross-coupling polycondensation... purified by Soxhlet extraction with dried methanol, petroleum ether, and toluene, and then with dried chloroform.

knowledge_points.content: AFM imaging indicates that P(DPPTT-T) forms a thicker and more interconnected nanofibrillar network morphology compared to P(DPPT-TT), facilitating more efficient charge transport.
knowledge_points.evidence: P(DPPTT-T) thin films possess not only a small RMS value (~1.07 nm), but also a thicker nanofibrillar structure, which are favourable for charge carrier transport.
